# Syed Hadi

> Syed Hadi is a product marketing and channel partnerships lead at AccuKnox, a Zero Trust CNAPP and AI security company, based in Bengaluru, India. He sells Claude skills for marketers and runs "in a box" growth projects for B2B SaaS and security startups, built around a 90 day roadmap.

Engagements come in three sizes. Small projects run 30 days (phase one of the roadmap), medium projects run 45 days, and long term work is scoped on a call. Pricing is shared by email on request. Every call ends with a draft 90 day plan.

## Growth in a box
- [GTM + PMM in a box](https://syedcreates.com/gtm-pmm-in-a-box): GTM and PMM as one 90 day program. Positioning, ICP, outbound, partners, launch and a pipeline dashboard, with Syed as fractional growth lead.
- [GTM in a box](https://syedcreates.com/gtm-in-a-box): 90 day go to market program for B2B SaaS and security startups. ICP, outbound, partner program and a pipeline dashboard.
- [PMM in a box](https://syedcreates.com/pmm-in-a-box): 90 day product marketing program. Positioning, messaging, battlecards, sales enablement and a launch.
- [AEO/SEO Ranking in a box](https://syedcreates.com/aeo-seo-in-a-box): 90 day program to rank in Google and get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Audit, technical fixes, buyer pages and AI visibility tracking.
- [Content in a box](https://syedcreates.com/content-in-a-box): 90 day B2B content program. Strategy, calendar, long form articles, a gated asset, founder LinkedIn posts and distribution.
- [Partner Revenue in a box](https://syedcreates.com/partner-revenue-in-a-box): 90 day partner led growth program. Partner mapping, recruitment, seller enablement, joint campaigns and joint pipeline reviews.
- [Schedule a meeting](https://syedcreates.com/schedule-meeting): free call on GTM, product marketing, AEO and SEO or content.

Prompt Polisher, Humanizer, Caveman Mode, Company Intel Dossier, UX Competitive Teardown, SEO Blog Grader, Content Calendar Studio and Webinar Calendar Link. Works in Claude.ai, the Claude desktop app and Claude Code.

## Free calculators and scorecards
- [Calculators hub](https://syedcreates.com/calculator): every free calculator and GTM scorecard on one page, each with a high fidelity PDF report.
- [Loan EMI and Prepay Planner](https://syedcreates.com/loan-calculator): EMI, total interest and a year by year schedule for home, car and personal loans; four strategies to close the loan in half the tenure (higher EMI, one lump sum a year, yearly EMI step up, 13 EMIs a year) with interest saved for each; and a prepay versus invest planner that spends the same cash on both paths, counts Section 24(b) and 80C benefits and taxes investment gains at 12.5% LTCG. Free PDF plan.
- [BMI Calculator and Healthy Habits Tracker](https://syedcreates.com/bmi-calculator): BMI scored on Asian Indian cut offs (healthy 18.5 to 22.9, overweight 23 to 24.9, obesity 25+) with the WHO category alongside, healthy weight range for your height, waist to height ratio, optional blood pressure, fasting glucose, HbA1c and SGPT checks, a personalised table of what to start doing and what to stop doing, and a 7 day habits tracker saved on the device. Free PDF plan with a printable tracker. Education only, not medical advice.
- [Car Mileage and Running Cost Calculator](https://syedcreates.com/car-mileage-calculator): monthly kilometres, mileage and petrol price in; litres per month, fuel cost compared across Delhi, Bengaluru and Hyderabad, cost per km, full tank range, fill ups per month and a yearly running cost with service and wear reserve out. Pre filled for a Maruti Suzuki Fronx (1,000 km a month at 15 km/L). Free PDF report.
- [Salary Growth Calculator India](https://syedcreates.com/salary-calculator): enter in hand salary, monthly needs and wants and the yearly increment to see salary, investable surplus and the PPF plus equity corpus for the next 45 years, in rupees and in today's money, with crorepati milestone ages, a vector PDF report and an emailed copy. Model: salary compounds by the increment, needs and wants grow at their own rates, PPF share equals age, PPF 8% tax free, equity 15% with 10% LTCG on gains, inflation 5%.
- [SEO and AEO Score Checker](https://syedcreates.com/seo-aeo-score): paste a URL and get an SEO score out of 60 (16 technical and on page checks), an AEO score out of 40 (structured data, entity schema, FAQ schema, llms.txt, AI crawler access, question led headings, direct answers, author and dates), Domain Rating with backlinks and referring domains from OpenSEO, and a prioritised action list.
- [Company Research Tool](https://syedcreates.com/company-research): paste a company homepage URL and a Firecrawl research agent returns market cap or valuation, headquarters, employee count, total customers, ARR, top 5 competitors, unique differentiators, why customers choose them, growth pain points (must fix and nice to fix) and missed revenue opportunities with fixes, each figure with a source and a HIGH, MEDIUM or UNVERIFIED confidence label, plus a one page PDF.
- [Qums Calculator (Shia)](https://syedcreates.com/qums): free Khums (Qums) calculator. Adds savings, removes exempt money and shows the 20% Khums with Sahm e Imam and Sahm e Sadat, with notes for followers of Ayatollah Sistani and Ayatollah Khamenei.
- [Mutual Fund Returns Tracker](https://syedcreates.com/mutual-fund-returns-calculator): 1, 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20 year returns of 50 popular Indian mutual funds across large, mid and small cap, index, flexi cap, ELSS, hybrid, debt, liquid and gold, with a SIP and lumpsum projector for 5, 10, 15 and 20 years.
- [FIRE Calculator India](https://syedcreates.com/fire-calculator): free financial independence and early retirement calculator for Indian investors in mutual funds and NSE or BSE stocks. FIRE number, SIP needed, earliest retirement age, Lean, Fat and Coast FIRE.
- [AI Visibility Checker](https://syedcreates.com/ai-visibility-checker): 10 question score for how likely ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI Overviews are to cite a brand.
- [Partner Program Readiness Score](https://syedcreates.com/partner-readiness-score): 10 question score for whether a SaaS partner program is ready to bring pipeline.
- [GTM Health Check](https://syedcreates.com/gtm-health-check): 10 question go to market health score for B2B SaaS and security startups.


## Pipeline Notes
- [The 6 GTM Plays Behind a 0 to $10M Security Startup](https://syedcreates.com/gtm-plays-behind-0-to-10m): Six GTM plays behind the AccuKnox 0 to $10M run, from positioning and community to AI search and partners, each tied to real numbers you can check.
- [How AI Search Put a CNAPP Vendor in the Answer](https://syedcreates.com/ai-search-cnapp-240-percent): How AccuKnox reached 27.72% AI visibility and the top Google answer for CNAPP vendors, plus the engine that grew sessions 240% in 90 days.
- [FIRE Math for Indian Salaried Employees, EPF to NPS](https://syedcreates.com/fire-math-epf-ppf-nps): The FIRE math Indian salaried employees skip. How EPF, PPF and NPS change your FIRE number, why 25x needs an inflation check, and a worked example.
- [The One Line Positioning Test Most Homepages Fail](https://syedcreates.com/one-line-positioning-test): A one line test for your homepage hero, built on April Dunford's positioning framework and MKT1 messaging advice, with a real repositioning example.
- [Partner Programs That Actually Ship Pipeline](https://syedcreates.com/partner-programs-that-ship-pipeline): Why most SaaS partner programs stall at the logo wall, what Jay McBain and Crossbeam data show, and the cadence that turns partners into pipeline.
- [How to Build $2M of Pipeline on a $100K Marketing Budget](https://syedcreates.com/2m-pipeline-100k-budget): The pipeline math behind $2M of influenced pipeline a year on a $100K budget, plus what Kyle Poyar's 2026 data and Atlassian teach about lean B2B demand.
- [23 B2B Content Types and the 5 I Would Keep](https://syedcreates.com/23-content-types-5-that-sold): We ran a 23 type content matrix and 12 live moments in one quarter. Here are the 5 formats I would keep with a small team, and why each earns its place.
- [Your Salary in 2046 and What to Do About It Now](https://syedcreates.com/salary-in-2046): Where your salary lands in 2046 with 9% raises, job switches and 5% inflation. A worked Indian example, in rupees and today's money, plus what to do now.
- [5 GTM Leaders Who Changed How I Work in 2026](https://syedcreates.com/gtm-lessons-from-leaders-2026): Five ideas from April Dunford, Kyle Poyar, Emily Kramer, Ethan Smith and Elena Verna, and how I would apply each one at a security startup.
- [0 to $10M, 10 GTM Lessons From 2026](https://syedcreates.com/0-to-10m-10-lessons): Ten year end GTM lessons from a 0 to $10M hypergrowth run at a cloud security startup, each tied to real work, numbers and outside research.
